/nexlev-series/escapade/tidal.html.description: Tidal pairs two slides with a long climbing run, so children always have a choice of what to do next. A pink wavy slide and a blue spiral slide come off the main tower, while climbing panels and a wavy net climber stretch out to one side. Moulded snail, bird and flower toppers sit on the posts. The structure takes 30 to 35 children and covers 30'6" x 21'7", with a safe play area of 36'6" x 27'7". That long shape fits along the edge of a society lawn or a school ground. Its listed skills are confidence, strength, leadership and self control. Tidal comes in mixed colours as part of our NexLev Escapade series. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope on Tidal are covered by a 3-year warranty. Send us the length of your site and we will see if it fits.
/nexlev-series/escapade/tidal.html.spec_paragraph: Tidal stands on a galvanised pipe frame, with roto-moulded slides and toppers and a play rope net climber. We install it self-standing or by grouting, depending on your ground. Allow the full 36'6" x 27'7" safe area and lay impact flooring at both slide exits. Check the net climber and the post toppers for loose fixings during routine maintenance.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.

image_descriptions call Tidal 'coastal-themed', but the main image (TIDAL-A.jpg) shows garden toppers: a snail, a bird, flowers and a dome. Copy describes what the image shows; confirm the intended theme.
Series copy calls the range wooden, but the warranty line covers only galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Confirm materials and any warranty on timber.

/nexlev-series/escapade/tri-trap.html.description: Tri Trap is a small climbing frame built on a triangle, with a different way up on each face. A green climbing wall, a ring ladder and a rope net lead to the top, and a pink slide brings children back down. Working out which face to try first builds problem solving, confidence and strength. Tri Trap takes 15 to 20 children. At 15'3" x 9'4", with a safe play area of 21'3" x 14'4", it needs little ground and fits a society corner or a preschool yard. It is an Escapade piece in mixed colours, and it also works as a climbing add-on beside a larger tower. The galvanised frame, moulded parts, laminates and rope have 3 years of warranty cover. Ask us to place it on a drawing next to your other equipment.
/nexlev-series/escapade/tri-trap.html.spec_paragraph: Tri Trap's triangular frame is galvanised pipe, which keeps it rigid on all three sides. The slide is roto-moulded and the net is play rope. Our team installs it self-standing or grouted. Keep the 21'3" x 14'4" safe area free of benches and planters, and check the ring ladder joints at every service.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/apex.html.description: Apex is a tepee-shaped play tower in Baby Blue from the Pinnacle series of our NexLev range. Its hexagonal tower carries a tube slide, a net tunnel climber leads up one side and a trail of stepping posts runs across the ground in front. Children hop the posts, crawl up the tunnel and come down the slide, a simple loop that a group can repeat. It holds 30 to 35 children. Plan for a product area of 24'10" x 22'7" and a safe play area of 30'10" x 28'7". The listed skills are strength, team building, hand and eye coordination and concentration. A housing society or school with a squarish lawn will find it easy to place. Its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry our standard 3-year warranty. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com for a layout drawing.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/apex.html.spec_paragraph: The Apex tower is built on galvanised pipe with a roto-moulded tube slide, and the net tunnel uses play rope. The stepping posts sit low, but they still need impact flooring around them. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Check the net tunnel and slide joints at each service, and keep the 30'10" x 28'7" area clear.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.
Pinnacle series copy calls the towers wooden, but the warranty line covers only galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Confirm materials and any warranty on timber.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/bouldering.html.description: Bouldering joins a climbing frame and a swing set in one structure. Children climb a ladder net to a raised net deck and leave by a purple and turquoise slide. Swing beams on either side carry belt swings, a nest swing hangs under the deck, and a row of hanging stepping pods and a ring traverse add more to try. It is listed for 50 to 55 children. The product area is 29'7" x 25'9". Allow a safe play area of 35'7" x 31'9", which leaves room for the swings to move. Skills it builds include problem solving, creative thinking and strength. A township park or a school that wants swings and climbing without buying two pieces should look at it. Warranty is 3 years on its galvanised pipe, moulded parts, laminates and rope. Ask us for a quote with the safe zone drawn in.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/bouldering.html.spec_paragraph: Bouldering has many moving parts, so the safe area matters more here than on a climbing-only frame. Keep the 35'7" x 31'9" zone clear and lay impact flooring under the swings, the pods and the slide exit. The frame is galvanised pipe, installed self-standing or grouted. Swing bearings fall under our 1-year cover on bearings and spare parts.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/capstone.html.description: Seen from above, Capstone spreads out like a star, with slides and nets running in several directions from its central tepee tower. That layout lets children climb up from more than one side at once. Pink slides, a striped tube slide, net climbers and a net tunnel give each arm of the star a different job. Capstone takes 40 to 45 children. Its product area is 31'8" x 31'6", almost square, and the safe play area is 37'8" x 37'6". A square plot in the middle of a society garden or a public park suits it well. Its skills list covers emotional intelligence, leadership and self-directed play. Colours are mixed. We cover the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded slides, composite laminates and play rope for 3 years. Share a site photo and we will check the fit.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/capstone.html.spec_paragraph: Capstone's tepee tower and arms are galvanised pipe, with roto-moulded slides and play rope for the nets and tunnel. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Since children can exit in several directions, impact flooring should cover the whole 37'8" x 37'6" area. Check every net fixing and slide joint at each service.

Skills are identical to Frisk and Crossette.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/crestro.html.description: Crestro is a four-seat see saw in Lemon Green, with two parallel beams on one shared pivot. Each beam has a moulded seat with a handle loop at both ends, so four children can ride at once, two facing two. Riders have to time their pushes with the child opposite, which builds concentration and confidence. Emotional intelligence is the third skill on its list. Crestro needs only 6'7" x 4'3" of ground and a safe play area of 12'7" x 10'3". That makes it easy to add to a society play area or a school ground next to bigger structures. It sits in the Pinnacle series of our NexLev range. The galvanised pipe and roto-moulded seats are covered for 3 years, with 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Tell us how many see saws your ground needs.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/crestro.html.spec_paragraph: Crestro's frame and beams are galvanised pipe, and the seats with handles are roto-moulded. It can stand on its own base or be grouted. Keep the 12'7" x 10'3" area clear so swinging feet do not meet other equipment, and lay impact flooring under each seat. Check the pivot for wear at routine services.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/glory.html.description: Glory sets two tepee towers apart and joins them with a rope net bridge. Red slides run off both towers, one of them a tube slide, and a climbing wall gives a harder way up. Children cross the bridge back and forth, so the structure works best for groups who like to explore. It takes 40 to 45 children. At 46'5" by 25'2", with a safe play area of 52'5" x 31'2", Glory is long rather than wide. It suits a strip along a park boundary or the side of a school ground. Listed skills are exploring, confidence, creative thinking and strength. It comes in mixed colours. Our 3-year warranty applies to the galvanised pipe, moulded slides, composite laminates and rope bridge. Send us your site dimensions and we will draw it in.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/glory.html.spec_paragraph: Glory's two towers are galvanised pipe, linked by a play rope bridge and fitted with roto-moulded slides. Each tower is installed self-standing or grouted, and the pair must be set level so the bridge hangs evenly. Keep the 52'5" x 31'2" zone clear. Inspect the bridge rope and its clamps at every service.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/groovy.html.description: Groovy is a cone-shaped net climber in Cherry Red that turns on a round base. Children climb the net while the cone rotates, so they have to hold on, shift their weight and work together to keep it moving. It suits 5 to 8 children at a time. Groovy covers only 5'1" x 5'1", and its safe play area is 8'1" x 8'1". That lets it fit into a small society garden or a gap between larger pieces. The skills it builds are self control and confidence. It is part of the Pinnacle series in our NexLev range and pairs well with a tepee tower from the same series. Its galvanised pipe and play rope net carry a 3-year warranty, while the bearing falls under our 1-year cover. Ask us where it can go on your plan.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/groovy.html.spec_paragraph: Groovy has a rotating base, so the bearing is the part to watch. Check it at every service as per our maintenance steps and replace worn parts early. The frame is galvanised pipe with a play rope net, installed self-standing or grouted. Keep the 8'1" x 8'1" zone clear and lay impact flooring right round the base.
flags: Age group and activities are 'NA' in the fact sheet; copy gives no age range.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/peak.html.description: Peak is a single tepee tower with a beam on each side. A curved climbing ladder with holds takes children up to the deck and a purple double slide brings them down. One beam carries a nest swing, and the other carries a row of hanging stepping pods to balance across. That gives one structure climbing, sliding, swinging and balancing, which helps a society with room for only one main piece. Peak is listed for 25 to 30 children. It needs a product area of 25'6" x 24'1" and a safe play area of 31'6" x 30'1". Skills on its list are problem solving, creative thinking, focus and self control. Peak is finished in mixed colours, and its pipes, moulded parts, laminates and play rope have a 3-year warranty. Call +91 902 830 2266 for a layout.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/peak.html.spec_paragraph: Peak's tower and side beams are galvanised pipe, with a roto-moulded slide. It is installed self-standing or grouted. The nest swing and the pods both move, which is why the safe area runs to 31'6" x 30'1". Check the swing hangers, pod chains and climbing holds at each service. Bearings and spare parts carry 1 year of cover.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/prime.html.description: Prime is the Sea Green twin-tower piece in our Pinnacle series. Two hexagonal tepee towers stand close together, joined by a rope net bridge, with green slides and a tube slide coming down and a climbing wall on one face. It is listed for 50 to 55 children at once. The product area is 35' x 27'7", a broad footprint for a society lawn or an open patch in a park. Children use the bridge to swap towers and pick a different slide each time, which gets them playing in groups. Skills listed are exploring, confidence and social skills. Because it is one colour, Prime sits quietly in a landscaped garden. Cover for 3 years applies to the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded slides, laminates and play rope. Ask for a quote and a safe zone drawing.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/prime.html.spec_paragraph: Prime's towers and bridge frame are galvanised pipe, fitted with roto-moulded slides and play rope for the bridge. It is installed self-standing or grouted. We will mark the safe zone on your layout drawing, with extra room at each slide exit. Check bridge tension and the climbing wall holds during routine maintenance.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/sway.html.description: Sway is a two-seat swing on an A-frame, with Knight Blue legs and a Cherry Red top beam. Moulded caps sit on top of the legs, and two flat seats hang from the beam on chains. Two children swing side by side, and its listed skills are confidence and social skills. The frame itself covers 10'3" x 5'10". Swings travel well beyond their frame, so the safe play area is larger, at 16'3" x 11'10". Plan that space before choosing a spot, and keep footpaths away from the front and back of the seats. Sway belongs to the Pinnacle series of our NexLev range and can stand beside any of its towers. The galvanised frame and moulded parts have a 3-year warranty, and bearings and spare parts have 1 year. Ask us for a drawing with the swing zone marked.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/sway.html.spec_paragraph: Sway's legs and beam are galvanised pipe, and the seats hang from the beam, so check the hangers, chains and seats at every service. Replace worn parts early. We fix it self-standing or grouted, whichever suits the ground. Lay impact flooring across the whole swing path inside the 16'3" x 11'10" area.

/nexlev-series/pinnacle/vertex.html.description: Vertex is a tepee-shaped net climber without a slide, built purely for climbing. A web net stretches across its hexagonal base, nets and a slatted panel cover the sides, and a green spiral rail with hanging rings winds around the outside. Children can climb the walls, move hand over hand along the rings or lie back on the web net. The product area is 14'7" x 12'8" and the safe play area is 19'7" x 17'8". That compact size lets a school or society add a serious climbing piece without giving up much ground. Listed skills are cognitive development, motor skills and self control. It comes in mixed colours. Vertex's galvanised pipe and play rope come with a 3-year warranty. Send us a photo of the spot you have in mind.
/nexlev-series/pinnacle/vertex.html.spec_paragraph: Vertex has a galvanised pipe frame strung with play rope nets. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Children hang from the ring rail, so lay impact flooring across the whole 19'7" x 17'8" area. Check the web net, the ring hangers and the rope clamps at each service.

/nexlev-series/solitaire/chalet.html.description: Chalet is a box-tower play structure from the Solitaire series of our NexLev range. Its towers are linked by a U-shaped net crawl tunnel, a ladder leads up, and a red and cream spiral tube slide brings children back down. Most of the fun is in the tunnel, where children crawl from one tower to the next before choosing to slide. Chalet holds 30 to 35 children. The product area is 24'8" x 18'9" and the safe play area is 30'8" x 24'9". That suits a mid-sized society garden or a school's junior play area. Skills listed for Chalet are strength, team building and self-directed play. It is finished in mixed colours. We give 3 years of warranty on the galvanised pipes, the roto-moulded slide, the composite laminates and the play rope. Ask us for a layout drawing for your garden.
/nexlev-series/solitaire/chalet.html.spec_paragraph: The towers of Chalet stand on galvanised pipe, with a roto-moulded tube slide and a play rope crawl tunnel. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Keep the 30'8" x 24'9" area clear and leave extra room at the slide exit. During maintenance, check the tunnel net for wear and the tube slide joints for gaps.

Solitaire series copy calls the range wooden, but the warranty line covers only galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Confirm materials.

/nexlev-series/solitaire/jager.html.description: Jager is built from two round towers shaped like barrels, joined by a rope net bridge. Red tube slides come down from the towers, and a net climber gives a second way up. Children run across the bridge, climb and slide out again, so play keeps moving between the two barrels. It takes 40 to 45 children. The product area is 34' x 27'7" and the safe play area is 40' x 33'7". A park, a township garden or a large school ground has room for it. Skills listed are exploring, confidence, social skills and critical thinking. Jager is part of our NexLev Solitaire series and comes in mixed colours. Its warranty runs 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded tube slides, composite laminates and play rope. Call us on +91 902 830 2266 to plan the space.
/nexlev-series/solitaire/jager.html.spec_paragraph: Jager's barrel towers sit on galvanised pipe, with roto-moulded tube slides and a play rope bridge and net climber. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Lay impact flooring under the bridge and at both slide exits within the 40' x 33'7" zone. Check the bridge clamps and tube slide joints at each service.
